title: Kollupitiya Residence – Legrand / BTicino MyHOME System Recovery & Modernization

date.notes: Project is ongoing. Ground Floor and 3rd Floor main recovery stages are completed; 1st and 2nd Floor work and new-device integration remain pending.

industry: Residential smart home and building automation
summary: Recovery and modernization of a large multi-floor legacy Legrand / BTicino MyHOME SCS home-automation installation at a private residence in Kollupitiya. The work involves reverse-engineering the existing system, identifying and mapping devices, recovering lighting and sensor functions, tracing faults, cleaning and reorganizing automation panels, validating floor-by-floor operation, and preparing the installation for staged modernization with new compatible devices. Ground Floor and 3rd Floor main recovery stages have been completed; the overall project remains ongoing.
problem: The residence had an aging multi-floor MyHOME automation system with incomplete legacy documentation and no usable original project file, requiring device discovery, physical verification, mapping, fault tracing and staged recommissioning before modernization could proceed safely.
scope: Existing MyHOME SCS BUS system reverse engineering and recovery
Bus scanning, device identification and address recovery
Room-by-room switch, relay and light-point mapping
Presence sensor identification, testing and timing verification
Relay actuator and dimmer channel verification
MH202 legacy controller / scenario-system investigation and recovery
F422 / BUS section topology investigation and verification
Panel-board cleaning, neatening, identification and fault tracing
AC-control related point checking where connected to the MyHOME system
Preparation of floor-wise mapping, device-ID and future-maintenance documentation
Staged planning for new-device integration and modernization
technologies: MyHOME Suite / bus scanning and configuration tools
outcome: Ground Floor and 3rd Floor main recovery stages are completed. Device mapping, testing, panel work and functional recovery have progressed sufficiently for those floors to enter normal use / feedback stages. 1st and 2nd Floor work and planned integration of incoming new devices remain pending, so the overall project is still ongoing.
evo_role: System recovery, reverse engineering, device mapping, fault diagnosis, panel-board restoration, configuration recovery, testing, recommissioning, documentation and modernization planning for a legacy residential MyHOME automation installation.

website.short_description: Ongoing multi-floor recovery and modernization of a legacy Legrand / BTicino MyHOME automation system, including device reverse-engineering, lighting and sensor mapping, panel restoration, fault diagnosis, configuration recovery and staged preparation for modern device integration.
